channel.title: Holistic Life: Healthy Habits for Nurses and Shift Workers
channel.description: Healthy Habits for Nurses and Shift Workers guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Lunch Ideas for Work: Easy Meal Prep for Nurses on 12-Hour Shifts
item.description: Lunch ideas for work do not need to be fancy, even on a 12 hour shift. Use the protein, grain and vegetable formula, batch cook once and pack for the week. Easy meal prep for nurses, with ideas that need no microwave. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Sleep Tips for Night Shift Workers: Make Your Room Truly Dark by Day
item.description: Sleep tips for night shift workers start with a dark room. Hang blackout curtains, cover the gaps at the edges, block light under the door and add a sleep mask. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with gear picks. Guide contains affiliate links.
